# PostEffect

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("PostEffect")`
- **Abstract**: it cannot be created; other classes inherit from it

The base class of the effects that change the finished picture instead of the world in it. Where an effect is parented decides who sees it. Directly under `Lighting`, it belongs to the world: it is saved with the scene and everyone sees it. Directly under `Workspace.CurrentCamera`, it applies to whoever looks through that camera. Anywhere else it does nothing, and the editor shows a warning on the instance.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the effect is applied. A disabled effect is not the same as no effect: a disabled `BloomEffect` still controls bloom, and turns it off. |
